Descripción: Louisiana consumers have rights when it comes to debt collection, debt defense, and debt settlement. The Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) both provide consumers with legal protection from debt collectors and creditors. A consumer credit attorney can help individuals understand their rights and protect them when violations happen. For instance, if a consumer is being harassed by a debt collector, they can seek legal assistance to defend their rights. Additionally, if a consumer is looking to settle their debt, they can work with a consumer credit attorney to negotiate a fair settlement. Finally, if a consumer is renting an apartment, they should be aware of their rights under the FDCPA and FCRA and state laws.
